search: Search by ID, name or mobile
name: Member name
idOnlyHelp: Save details first. Face registration is optional; the member ID always works.
deleteConfirm: Delete this member and all their personal details, consent, face data and event registrations? This cannot be undone.
experimental: Face enrollment is experimental. Accuracy validation with volunteers is still pending.
facePending: Face registration is awaiting validation. You can register members by ID now.
withdraw: Withdraw face consent and remove face data
agree: The member or guardian has read the text and agrees
cameraError: Could not open the camera or record consent. Close this step, check camera permission and try again.
checkCapturedFrame: Check the image sent for face detection
checkCapturedFrameHelp: This is the last rejected capture. It should look like the camera preview. If it is blank or scrambled, the browser may be blocking image capture. This preview is temporary and is not saved to the member record.
capturedFrameAlt: Last image sent for face detection
captureGuide: One person at a time. Look straight ahead in good light, then capture three slightly different views.
duplicateHelp: A similar face is already registered. Compare the reference photos before saving.
overrideDuplicate: Different people — save and record override
pickEvent: Choose an event or create one to begin.
importHelp: Import details or event choices from CSV or Excel (.xlsx). Imports never create face consent. Preview first; rows are saved together only when all are valid.
importColumns: Keep the template headers unchanged. For members, is_minor must be true or false. For choices, use option codes from the event counts CSV. Excel files use the same headers.
importValid: All rows passed validation. Ready to save.
resetHelp: Resetting a PIN signs that staff account out on every device.
welcomeHelp: Register members, record consent and organize event choices.
loginHelp: Use the staff account created during local setup.
setupHelp: First time? Create the administrator using the local setup command in the README.
rolePending: You are signed in. Your event-day workflow will be available in a later milestone.
m1Pending: M4 development · Face accuracy validation pending

errors.unexpected: Could not finish. Check the local server and try again.
errors.connection: Cannot reach the local server. Check the connection, then try again.
errors.login_failed: Sign-in failed. Check the username and PIN. After five failed attempts, wait five minutes.
errors.invalid_session: Your session changed. Sign out and sign in again.
errors.invalid_origin: Open the app from its configured local address.
errors.setup_required: Server setup is incomplete. Follow the README to initialize the database and administrator.
errors.storage_unavailable: Database unavailable. Start the local database and try again.
errors.invalid_request: Check the required fields and input formats.
errors.duplicate_or_in_use: That code already exists or this record is still in use.
errors.stale_record: This record changed. Select it again to load the latest version before saving.
errors.member_code_immutable: A member ID cannot be changed.
errors.consent_required: Record consent before capturing a face.
errors.guardian_required: A parent or guardian must consent for a member under 18.
errors.consent_changed: The consent text changed. Record consent again.
errors.face_disabled: Face capture is disabled while validation is pending.
errors.three_distinct_frames: Capture three different frames before saving.
errors.invalid_image: Could not use this image. Retake it.
errors.no_face: No face detected. Face the camera, move into the centre and add light in front of you.
errors.one_person: More than one face detected. Keep only one person in the camera view.
errors.whole_face: Keep your whole face inside the camera view.
errors.duplicate_code: Each member, slot and option needs a unique code.
errors.counter_options: Assign every option to at least one counter.
errors.event_structure_locked: Event structure is locked after registration or marking ready.
errors.choose_each_slot: Choose an option for every slot.
errors.invalid_option: Choose an option that belongs to this slot.
errors.event_closed: This event is closed and cannot be changed.
errors.invalid_transition: This event cannot move to that status.
errors.no_registrations: Add at least one member with choices before marking ready.
errors.invalid_import: Use a valid CSV or .xlsx file, up to 1,000 rows and 2 MB, without formulas.
errors.invalid_columns: The columns do not match the template.
errors.invalid_minor: is_minor must be true or false.
errors.member_not_found: The member ID does not exist.
errors.invalid_or_duplicate_row: Check this row for invalid values or a duplicate member ID.
errors.event_not_live: Ask an admin to start this event before check-in.
errors.not_registered: No choice is registered for this member and slot. Ask an admin.
errors.confirmation_expired: This confirmation expired. Scan or search again.
errors.selection_changed: The member choice changed. Search again before confirming.
errors.already_issued: A coupon already exists for this member and slot. Search to retrieve it.
errors.signing_setup_required: Ask an admin to provision the server signing key.
errors.coupon_unavailable: This coupon is no longer available for download.
errors.request_reused: This retry key was used for different details. Start a new action.
errors.coupon_replaced: This coupon already has a replacement. Search for the latest coupon.
errors.redemption_conflict: The coupon state changed. Scan again to check its current status.
